title: 第21章 幕后的神秘女巫组织第22章 麻烦又危险的新招募对象
slug: 是攻略系统不是攻城略地系统
content_zh:
看到身陷幻梦魔法中的李凯南，脸上终于露出了真挚笑容，似乎是彻底沉沦其中无法自拔了。
女巫盖丽不由冷笑一声，道：
“在幻梦魔法之中，你现在变成了爱洛公主……”
女巫阿加特闻言，也是语带嘲讽地道：
“没想到这样实力强大、意志坚定的骑士，居然也抵挡不住爱洛公主的美貌……”
两位女巫对那位爱洛公主明显带着嫉妒心思，所以难得一次统一了意见。
“呵，男人都这样……”
“没错，真是够肤浅的！”
而觉得自己抬手间就能取走李凯南的性命，女巫阿加特脸上的狠辣阴毒之色消失，再度变得仁慈宽容起来。
既然如此，如此仁爱慈悲的我就饶恕你的罪过，大度地允许你死在这样的美梦之中吧！
她周身的金色光芒也变得越发耀眼，整个人就宛若降临凡间的女神一般，让人有顶礼膜拜的冲动……
……
幻境之中，拥有着绝世美貌的“爱洛公主”走到了李凯南的面前，身上散发着朦胧柔光让人不由想要跪倒在她的裙摆之下。
李凯南看着面前这位对自己露出倾慕之色的绝世佳人，正色道：
“我已经等你很久了！”
一旁的贝儿瞪大了眼睛，然后顿时变得慌张了起来。
自己深爱着的丈夫难道要被爱洛公主抢走了？
可不曾想下一刻，穿着华丽公爵礼仪服饰，身上并未携带任何利刃的李凯南忽然右手按在了腰间，做出了拔剑挥击的姿态。
李凯南原本空无一物的手中，忽然出现了一柄华丽无比，刃口泛着凛冽锋芒的骑士剑。
而面前这位的“爱洛公主”，身上却是直接迸溅出滚烫的鲜血，然后面露茫然地倒了下去……

李凯南有“？？之眼”，知道眼前这人根本不是什么爱洛公主！
她头顶上浮现的，是用红色字体显示的名字【阿加特】。
绿色代表友方单位，那红色自然就代表敌方单位了！
在这处幻境之中冷眼旁观，时刻保持着清醒，直到这个时候李凯南才终于等到幕后之人出现了！
但不知为何，李凯南在斩杀了此人之后幻境依旧没有消失。
宴会之上的那些贵族们就好似没看到这让人惊骇的一幕，仍旧继续奏乐继续舞。
此时唯有贝儿、亚当王子，震惊又费解地看着对“爱洛公主”悍然出手的李凯南。
而坐在国王身后的王后，此时更是惊恐地发出了尖叫声。
李凯南猛地抬头看去，“王后”的头顶上也浮现着红名【盖丽】。
怪不得幻境没有消失，原来还有同伙儿！
李凯南又将手伸向了原本空无一物的腰间，凭空抽出了一柄骑士斧，然后狠狠甩出。
骑士斧携带着恐怖劲风，眨眼之间便已经砸中了那名“王后”的胸口，然后直接将她给钉在了地上！
“王后”震惊地看着洞穿自己胸口的斧头，一句话都没来得及说便彻底失去了气息。
也是“王后”的死去，眼前这王宫盛大舞会的美妙幻境失去了魔力维持，终于彻底消散开来……
……
城堡大厅之中，李凯南猛地睁开了眼睛，环顾四周。
一名被一剑砍中胸口的女巫，躺在了地上气息断绝。
content_en:
Seeing Li Kainan trapped in the dream magic, a sincere smile finally appeared on his face, and he seemed to be completely immersed in it and unable to extricate himself.
Witch Gaili couldn't help but sneered and said:
"In the magic of dreams, you have now become Princess Aurora..."
When the witch Agathe heard this, she also said mockingly:
"I didn't expect that such a powerful and determined knight could not resist the beauty of Princess Aurora..."
The two witches were obviously jealous of Princess Aurora, so it was a rare occasion for them to agree on the same opinion.
"Oh, all men are like this..."
"Yes, it's really superficial!"
And feeling that she could take Li Kainan's life with just a raise of her hand, the cruel and sinister look on the face of the witch Agathe disappeared, and she became kind and tolerant again.
In this case, I, who is so kind and compassionate, will forgive your sins and generously allow you to die in such a beautiful dream!
The golden light around her became more and more dazzling, and she looked like a goddess descending into the mortal world, making people have the urge to worship...
…
In the fantasy world, "Princess Ailuo" with peerless beauty walked up to Li Kainan. Her body exuded a hazy and soft light that made people want to kneel down under her skirt.
Li Kainan looked at the peerless beauty in front of him who showed admiration for him, and said seriously:
"I've been waiting for you for a long time!"
Beside her, Belle's eyes widened, and then she suddenly became panicked.
Is the husband she loves so much about to be snatched away by Princess Aurora?
But he never thought that the next moment, Li Kainan, who was wearing a gorgeous ducal ceremonial dress and did not carry any sharp blade, suddenly put his right hand on his waist and made a gesture of drawing a sword and striking.
In Li Kainan's originally empty hand, an extremely gorgeous knight's sword suddenly appeared with a sharp edge.
But the "Princess Aurora" in front of her had hot blood splattered on her body, and then she fell down with a dazed look on her face...
Li Kainan has the "?? Eyes" and knows that the person in front of him is not Princess Aurora at all!
What appeared above her head was the name [Agathe] displayed in red font.
Green represents friendly units, and red naturally represents enemy units!
In this illusion, he watched with cold eyes and remained awake at all times. It was only then that Li Kainan finally waited for the person behind the scenes to appear!
But for some reason, the illusion still did not disappear after Li Kainan killed this man.
The nobles at the banquet seemed not to have seen this horrifying scene and continued to play music and dance.
At this time, only Belle and Prince Adam looked at Li Kainan with shock and confusion as he attacked "Princess Aurora".
The queen, who was sitting behind the king, screamed in horror.
Li Kainan suddenly looked up and saw the red name [Gai Li] floating above the head of the "Queen".
No wonder the illusion has not disappeared, it turns out there are still accomplices!
Li Kainan reached out to his empty waist again, pulled out a knight's ax out of thin air, and then threw it out hard.
The knight's ax carried a terrifying force of wind, and in the blink of an eye it hit the "Queen" in the chest, and then nailed her to the ground!
The "Queen" looked at the ax that pierced her chest in shock, and completely lost her breath before she could say a word.
It was also the death of the "Queen". The wonderful illusion of the grand ball in the palace lost its magical power and finally completely dissipated...
…
In the castle hall, Li Kainan suddenly opened his eyes and looked around.
A witch was struck in the chest by a sword and lay on the ground without breath.
